description: Daily EURUSD naive momentum (f_mom_12), fractional Kelly 0.25, min_edge=breakeven, real signed carry financing, measured 0.2-pip spread.
rationale: Research-only (2015-2022) walk-forward gives net Sharpe 0.794, CI [0.107,1.626], 6 folds, turnover 67/yr, non-degenerate. Out-of-sample decay of roughly half is typical for a single-feature price signal, so 0.40 is predicted rather than 0.79. Confirmation requires landing in [-0.10, 0.90] AND being positive. CAVEAT: ~33 configurations were searched over the FULL 2015-2026 sample in earlier sessions before this holdout was carved out, so the holdout is partially contaminated -- my priors saw it even though this formal selection did not.
